name: the tour form is tried before the festival form
why: "Hellfest 2023, Day 1: Mainstage 01" is a festival edition with a day and stage after it, not a tour stop; the festival check must run first.

name: a week number counts as a festival edition
why: "The KISS Kruise XI, Week 2" is free form; without the day/week guard every "Day 1" or "Week 2" name reads as a festival.

name: the ev prefix is not stripped before the live matcher
why: The evlive… modes reuse _liveTitleMatchesMode(); handed the prefixed mode it matches nothing, so ticking a live-form entry on the Event column empties the table.

name: location parts are counted off by one
why: The Location completeness entries must name the real number of ", "-separated parts.

name: the location matcher is missing
why: Without the liveloc: branch a ticked Location completeness entry matches no row.

name: event columns are not stamped with the live flag
why: The red/yellow live-form tint reaches event names only because _liveTitleColIdxs() includes the event-name columns.

name: the event findings never test the Event column
why: Every event FINDINGS entry gates its columns through plan.eventName(); a gate that says no leaves the menus without the event rows and style near misses untinted.

name: the rendering is not gated by the event-name column set
why: Recorded as a pass on purpose: the counting loop is gated by isEventNameCol too, so on any other column every counter is zero and _pushSyn()/_pushVals() push nothing. The render gate is a second guard the spec cannot see while the count gate covers for it.

name: the setting does not hide the sections
